_comment: Pipeline: Full profile validation — convert to canonical Turtle, then validate against constraints.
_how_to_use: Fill in all REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar run pipeline-full-validation.json
name: Full profile validation
description: Convert CGMES model files to canonical Turtle, then validate against SHACL constraints.
_note_stopOnError: true = pipeline aborts if any step fails (exit >= 2). Violations (exit 1) do not stop the pipeline unless stopOnViolations is also true.
_note_stopOnViolations: false = pipeline continues even if violations are found. Set to true to treat violations as a hard failure.

steps.name: Convert to canonical Turtle
steps._note: Converts the RDF/XML model to sorted Turtle so git diffs are meaningful.
steps._note_input: Source file. Extension determines format: .xml/.rdf = RDF/XML, .ttl = Turtle.
steps._note_xmlBase: Must match the CGMES version. CGMES 3.0: http://iec.ch/TC57/CIM100. CGMES 2.4: http://iec.ch/TC57/2013/CIM-schema-cim16.

steps.name: Validate against SHACL constraints
steps._note: Runs the mapping-based validation. Results go to the outputDir folder.
steps._note_mappingCsv: CSV mapping file linking model sets to constraint .ttl files. Three columns: models | constraint.ttl | label.
steps._note_constraintsRoot: Root folder for .ttl constraint files. Constraint paths in the CSV are relative to this.
